summary: LLM-OSDA proposes an optimal-stopping dynamic auction mechanism for native advertising embedded in multi-turn LLM conversations. This system allows sponsored content to be integrated directly into model-generated responses, optimizing for timing within evolving discussions.

title: DiffusionGemma Technical Report
summary: DiffusionGemma is introduced as an experimental open-weight language model that generates text rapidly using discrete diffusion. It achieves high speed by iteratively refining blocks of 256 tokens in parallel, bypassing the sequential decoding bottleneck.

title: A Constitution-Grid Instrument for Data-Efficient RL Alignment (C-Guard)
summary: This paper introduces C-Guard, a Constitution-Grid Instrument for data-efficient Reinforcement Learning (RL) alignment with conflicting objectives. It focuses on training safety guards to balance catching real harm with avoiding over-refusal of benign prompts.

title: Averaging Bias: Human Faithfulness Annotations are not Locally Faithful
summary: This research identifies an "Averaging Bias" in human faithfulness annotations for text summarization, showing they are not locally faithful. It critiques current faithfulness evaluation methods where unsupported sentences in a summary render the whole output unfaithful, highlighting issues in how we evaluate AI trustworthiness.

title: Bridging the English-Arabic Medical Knowledge Gap: Targeted Low-Rank Adaptation via Causal Layer Selection
summary: This research investigates the English-Arabic medical knowledge gap in LLMs, attributing performance degradation in Arabic to limited training data. It proposes targeted low-rank adaptation via causal layer selection to bridge this gap, enhancing LLMs for cross-lingual medical tasks.

title: A Few Neurons Reveal When LLMs Misuse Tools: Sparse Detection and Selective Steering for Reliable Tool Use
summary: This paper explores how a few neurons can reveal and help steer agentic LLMs away from tool misuse. It introduces a method for sparse detection and selective steering to improve reliable tool use, addressing failures like invalid arguments, over-calling, and omitted calls.

title: Cross-Task Dissociation in Frontier Vision-Language Model Theory of Mind
summary: This research evaluates whether frontier vision-language models demonstrate a coherent Theory-of-Mind (ToM) profile across different tasks. It uses psychology-derived benchmarks to investigate potential cross-task dissociation in VLM cognitive abilities.

title: Sixteen models, fewer than two voices: measuring ensemble dispersion where no answer is uniquely correct
summary: This study measures the semantic diversity of outputs from sixteen language models across ten families when formulating a psychotherapeutic case. It evaluates ensemble dispersion to understand how models provide varied interpretations for subjective problems.

title: SeDeM: Selective Decompression of Hidden-State Memories for Long-Context Question Answering
summary: SeDeM introduces selective decompression of hidden-state memories to address the cost and reliability issues of long-context inference in LLMs. This method aims to optimize KV cache usage for efficient and effective long-context question answering.

title: CurveShift: Is Agent Progress Scalar? Separating Level from Shape
summary: CurveShift proposes a new method to evaluate progress in large language models by separating "level" from "shape," questioning if agent progress is purely scalar. It critiques current aggregate benchmark scores, suggesting a more nuanced approach to measure performance across varied task difficulties.

title: Deep Research Pretraining via Predictive Navigation
summary: This paper introduces Deep Research Pretraining (DRP), an offline framework designed to train deep research agents more efficiently. DRP derives predictive navigation supervision from natural language, focusing on tool-use trajectories, retrieval, and document inspection.

title: AdaMTP: An Adaptive Training Paradigm for Multi-Token Prediction
summary: AdaMTP proposes an adaptive training paradigm for Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) in Large Language Models. This new approach augments LLM backbones with auxiliary heads to predict multiple future tokens in parallel, enriching supervision and accelerating inference.

title: SERL-SQL: Selective Hindsight Distillation for Text-to-SQL Reinforcement Agentic Learning
summary: SERL-SQL introduces Selective Hindsight Distillation to improve Text-to-SQL systems that rely on multi-turn interaction and reinforcement learning. This method enhances agentic learning by providing more granular guidance on SQL decisions beyond trajectory-level rewards.

title: The Learning Objective Governs Perceptual Narrowing: A Cross-Lingual, Layer-Wise, Ten-Seed Study of Self-Supervised Speech Encoders
summary: This paper studies how the learning objective influences perceptual narrowing in self-supervised speech encoders, using a Transformer encoder model.

title: S$^4$R: Selective Sampling, Subspaces, and Sparse Reconstruction for Compressed Long-Context KV Caching
summary: This research introduces S$^4$R, a method using selective sampling, subspaces, and sparse reconstruction to compress the Key-Value (KV) cache in LLMs for more efficient long-context processing.

title: Native Multilingual Chain-of-Thought Reasoning in Low-Resource Southeast Asian Languages
summary: This paper explores improving native multilingual Chain-of-Thought reasoning in Large Language Models for low-resource Southeast Asian languages, addressing issues like cross-lingual collapse.

title: DE-NER : Zero-shot Named Entity Recognition via Dialogue Elicitation of Large Language Models
summary: This paper proposes DE-NER, a method for zero-shot Named Entity Recognition that leverages dialogue elicitation from Large Language Models to overcome prompt limitations.

title: Writing-System-Level Tokenizer Adaptation for Byte-Level BPE
summary: This research investigates post-hoc adaptation methods for byte-level BPE tokenizers to segment underrepresented languages more efficiently without fully retraining the model-vocabulary.

title: Verification Without Sufficiency: Per-Chunk Filtering Fails on Multi-Hop RAG, and Decomposition Repairs It
summary: This paper shows that per-chunk filtering fails for multi-hop Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and proposes a decomposition method to repair this limitation.

title: A Heuristic Perspective on Debiasing Language Models
summary: This paper examines existing methods for debiasing language models, such as counterfactual augmentation, to mitigate social harm caused by acquired biases.

title: TreeProbe : A Tibetan Medicine Benchmark for Cultural Bias in LLMs
summary: TreeProbe is introduced as a new benchmark for evaluating cultural bias in Large Language Models, specifically focusing on their coverage and representation of traditional Tibetan medicine.

title: Select-And-Extract: A Lightweight Plugin for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: Select-And-Extract is a lightweight plugin designed to improve Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) by addressing common retrieval and reading failure modes in language model systems.

title: OpenART: Scaling Agent Red Teaming via Open-Ended Environment Evolution
summary: OpenART is a method to scale red teaming for AI agents by using open-ended environment evolution to assess their behavior in persistent, long-horizon workflows and improve safety.

title: AttnLink: Turning Attention into Schema Links for Text-to-SQL
summary: AttnLink is an attention-based framework that converts LLMs' internal attention into continuous relevance scores for efficient schema linking in Text-to-SQL systems.

title: Exploiting Intrinsic Duality for Multi-Hop Question Generation
summary: This paper explores exploiting the intrinsic duality between multi-hop question generation and question answering to improve the process of generating complex questions from documents.

title: RAGOCR: Optical Compression of Retrieval-Augmented Text via Visual Representation
summary: RAGOCR is a method for optical compression of retrieval-augmented text using visual representation to reduce computational costs for Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems.

title: Distill Where You Fail: Recovering Learning Signals of Negative RL-Groups from Adaptive Teacher Guidance
summary: This paper proposes a method to recover learning signals for negative RL-Groups from adaptive teacher guidance, improving post-training of large language models using reinforcement learning.

title: OoO-Spec: Out-of-Order Semantic Speculation for Fast Tool Calling
summary: OoO-Spec introduces out-of-order semantic speculation to enable faster and more parallel generation of tool calls and argument values by Large Language Models.

title: Exemplars in Disguise: Pure Exemplar Models Mimic Abstraction-First Learning
summary: This paper explores how pure exemplar models can mimic abstraction-first learning, addressing a central question in language learning and its implications for large language models.

title: Pruned BPE: Post-training Visibility Pruning and Token Reallocation for Byte Pair Encoding
summary: Pruned BPE is a method for optimizing Byte Pair Encoding through post-training visibility pruning and token reallocation, improving subword tokenization efficiency.

title: Practical Online KV Cache Compaction for LLM Agents: An Empirical Study
summary: This empirical study investigates practical online KV cache compaction methods to reduce the inference bottleneck caused by long reasoning trajectories in LLM agents.

title: FinHardBench: Can LLMs Generate Latency-Aware Hardware for Financial Computing?
summary: FinHardBench is a new benchmark designed to assess the ability of Large Language Models to generate latency-aware hardware designs for financial computing, specifically FPGA designs.

title: Gaokerena: A Small Persian Medical Language Model Family
summary: Gaokerena is a new family of small Persian Medical Language Models introduced to address the underserved need for AI in medical question-answering systems for low-resource languages.

title: Unsupervised Multidomain Approaches to Named Entity Recognition with Small Datasets
summary: This paper investigates methodologies for unsupervised multidomain Named Entity Recognition (NER) in scenarios with small, unlabelled datasets, focusing on transfer learning for information extraction.

title: MedUPS: Towards Diagnostic Assistance in Uncommon Medical Cases with Large Language Models
summary: This paper explores using Large Language Models (LLMs) to provide diagnostic assistance in uncommon medical cases, aiming to improve clinical decision support beyond just final diagnoses.

title: Cloud-ScPO: Hidden-State Geometry for Semi-Supervised Preference Optimization in LLM Reasoning
summary: This paper introduces Cloud-ScPO, a method for semi-supervised preference optimization in Large Language Models (LLMs) to enhance mathematical reasoning by leveraging the model's internal hidden states.

title: Why LLMs Give In: Conversational Factors and Reasoning Behind Medical Sycophancy
summary: This study investigates "medical sycophancy" in Large Language Models (LLMs), where models abandon correct medical answers under user pushback, exploring its conversational factors and reasoning.

title: Opt.Gear Technical Report
summary: This technical report introduces Opt.Gear, a foundation model with a new hybrid architecture designed for efficient on-device deployment, real-time inference, and strong task capabilities across various sizes.

title: DeBERTa-Sentinel: Toward Transparent and Trustworthy Detection of AI-Generated Text
summary: This paper introduces DeBERTa-Sentinel, a system designed for transparent and trustworthy detection of AI-generated text to address concerns regarding misinformation and academic integrity.

title: Attend to Your Own Thoughts: Breaking the Barrier for Post-Training Quantization of Reasoning LLMs through the Lens of 1.58-Bit Quantization
summary: This paper proposes ScaleQ-1.58, a scalable ternary post-training quantization framework for reasoning Large Language Models (LLMs), which aims to improve efficiency by leveraging insights into their chain-of-thought reasoning.

title: ELECTRIC: Evidential Learning-Enhanced CT Reconstruction via Iterative Correction
summary: This paper introduces ELECTRIC, a physics-guided Bayesian formulation for CT reconstruction that uses an evidential neural network to provide image proposals and predict epistemic uncertainty for adaptive precision.

title: Noise-Robust Conditional Flow Matching: Generating Clean Samples from Noisy Datasets
summary: This paper presents a noise-robust conditional flow matching method designed for generative models to create clean samples from noisy datasets, which is important for high-quality generation in fields like scientific imaging.

title: PhysAgent: A Multi-Agent Framework for Reliable Remote Heart Rate Estimation
summary: This paper introduces PhysAgent, a multi-agent framework designed for reliable remote heart rate estimation from facial videos, addressing common issues like motion and illumination changes.

title: SafeBuild-Bench: A Temporal-Robust Construction Safety Benchmark with Graph-Enhanced Data Mining
summary: This paper introduces SafeBuild-Bench, a new construction safety benchmark that focuses on temporal robustness and uses graph-enhanced data mining to evaluate models for real-world deployment risks.

title: Empirical investigation of 3D CT Foundation Models and Unsupervised Adaptation for Head and Neck Cancer Recurrence Prediction
summary: This paper empirically investigates 3D CT foundation models and unsupervised adaptation techniques for predicting head and neck cancer recurrence, offering an alternative to traditional radiomics.

title: Volcanic Clouds Detection through QCNN and Geostationary Satellite Multispectral Imagery
summary: This paper explores the use of Quantum Convolutional Neural Networks (QCNN) for detecting volcanic clouds from geostationary satellite multispectral imagery, leveraging quantum machine learning for Earth Observation.

title: Beyond Random Partitioning: Unsupervised Spatio-Temporal Stratification for Cohort Balancing in Longitudinal Medical Imaging
summary: This paper proposes an unsupervised spatio-temporal stratification method for rigorous dataset partitioning and cohort balancing in longitudinal medical imaging, aiming to prevent covariate shifts and sampling imbalances.

title: Explainable Multimodal AI for Adaptive Calibration of Archaeological Sensing Workflows
summary: This paper presents an explainable multimodal machine-learning framework designed for adaptive calibration, quality assessment, and acquisition support in archaeological digitization workflows.

title: Which Modality Decides? Counterfactual Modality Attribution for Multimodal LLMs
summary: This paper introduces counterfactual modality attribution, a method for Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) to determine which modality, image or text, primarily influences a specific decision.

title: Beyond Accuracy: Auditing Spatial Provenance in Visual Token Pruning for OCR-Critical MLLM Inference
summary: This paper proposes auditing spatial provenance in visual token pruning for OCR-critical Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM) inference, revealing limitations of solely relying on answer quality for evaluation.

title: Device-First Feedback: Toward Mobile-Native LLM-Driven Neural Architecture Search
summary: This paper presents an automated mobile deployment framework for Large Language Model (LLM)-generated convolutional neural networks, focusing on optimizing their performance and usability on real mobile hardware.

title: LeapTalk: Breaking the Latency-Quality Trade-off in Talking Head Generation
summary: This paper introduces LeapTalk, a method designed to generate long-form and real-time talking heads, aiming to overcome the existing latency-quality trade-off in current generation approaches.

title: Beyond Edge Maps: Wavelet-Domain Conditioning for Multi-Adapter Map-to-Satellite Diffusion
summary: This paper proposes a new method using wavelet-domain conditioning for multi-adapter map-to-satellite diffusion, enabling the synthesis of satellite imagery from cartographic data for low-resource regions.

title: From Pixels to PCells: A Neurosymbolic Approach to Photonic Component Creation
summary: PixCell is a neurosymbolic system utilizing multimodal agents to convert a visual photonic component into a parametric program using a domain-specific language.

title: DS@GT ARC at MEDIQA-CORE-Task-1 2026: Trimodal Model Fusion with Task-Specific Gates for Brain Tumor Subtype Classification
summary: This paper details a trimodal model fusion approach with task-specific gates for brain tumor subtype classification using multimodal inputs, as part of a medical imaging challenge.

title: DODA: A Database of Datasets for Aesthetics Research
summary: DODA is a database of diverse image datasets annotated for aesthetics, designed to assist researchers in finding suitable data for empirical and computational aesthetics studies.

title: Video Models as Native 4D Renderers: World-Grounded Conditioning from Animated Mesh
summary: This research explores using pretrained video diffusion models as native 4D renderers, conditioned by animated meshes and camera trajectories for generative rendering.

title: Logographic Character Visual Pretraining via Semantic-based Contrastive Learning
summary: This study proposes a logographic character visual pretraining method based on semantic-based contrastive learning to enhance tasks like text recognition and historical text completion.

title: SPARC-Rad: A Multimodal Benchmark Dataset and Evaluation Pipeline for Spatial and Anatomical Reasoning in Radiology Vision-Language Models
summary: SPARC-Rad introduces a multimodal benchmark dataset and evaluation pipeline specifically for assessing spatial and anatomical reasoning capabilities in radiology vision-language models.

title: What Carries the Signal in Pathology Foundation-Model Atlases? A Patient-Level Controlled Benchmark in Breast Cancer
summary: This paper presents a patient-level controlled benchmark in breast cancer to investigate which components of pathology foundation models are most effective at encoding molecular programs from tissue morphology.

title: Distill What RGB Can Recover: Privileged 3D Evidence for RGB-Only Vision-Language Models
summary: This work focuses on improving 3D scene understanding for RGB-only Vision-Language Models by distilling privileged 3D evidence, addressing limitations of insufficient 3D cues from RGB images.

title: Counting the Cost of War Under Satellite Embargo: Zero-Shot Estimation of Impacted Infrastructure
summary: This research presents a zero-shot geometric projection method to estimate impacted infrastructure in conflict zones, bypassing satellite imagery embargoes for humanitarian response.

title: RadPRISM: Schema-stratified radiology-report supervision for concept-disentangled image representations and visual grounding
summary: RadPRISM proposes schema-stratified radiology-report supervision to learn concept-disentangled image representations and improve visual grounding in medical vision-language pretraining.

title: SCALP: Semi-Supervised Statistical Shape Modeling from Imperfect 3D Photogrammetry via Landmark-Anchored Spectral Warp
summary: SCALP is a semi-supervised statistical shape modeling method that processes imperfect 3D photogrammetry data using a landmark-anchored spectral warp, improving morphometric analysis in clinical settings.

title: Manifold-GS: Certified Hybrid Assets via Varifold-Conservative Gaussian Splatting
summary: Manifold-GS converts 3D Gaussian Splatting into certified hybrid assets, ensuring more structured and geometrically consistent representations for novel-view synthesis.

title: Learning How Much, Not Just What: Cross-Patient Burden Order for CT Vision-Language Pretraining
summary: This paper introduces a method for CT vision-language pretraining that learns both the presence and the severity (burden order) of findings, improving 3D representation learning from scan-report pairs.

title: Real-Time Visual Obstruction Detection in Surgical Augmented Reality
summary: This research addresses a challenge in surgical augmented reality by developing a real-time visual obstruction detection system to prevent virtual content from blocking critical real-world information.

title: Attention-Steered Vision-Language Models for Sign Language Translation
summary: This study investigates attention-steered vision-language models for sign language translation, addressing limitations in spatial-temporal visual grounding of existing VLM-based translators.

title: Latent-Centroid Steering: Single-Pass Classifier-Free Guidance for Command-Aligned Autonomous Driving
summary: Latent-Centroid Steering is presented as a single-pass classifier-free guidance technique to improve command-aligned performance in vision-language models for autonomous driving, reducing command-following errors.

title: Semantically Calibrated Evidence Composition for CT Vision-Language Learning
summary: This paper proposes a semantically calibrated evidence composition method for CT vision-language learning, combining whole-volume context with anatomy-specific evidence to learn transferable representations.

title: MDWD: A Street-Level Dataset for Municipal Solid Waste Detection in Dense Urban Environments
summary: MDWD is introduced as a street-level dataset specifically for municipal solid waste detection in dense urban environments, filling a gap in existing benchmark resources for computer vision research.

title: Interpretability-Guided Soft Pruning of Attention Heads in Vision Transformers
summary: This research proposes an interpretability-guided soft pruning method for attention heads in Vision Transformers, offering an efficient and interpretable solution for large vision foundation models.

title: ORCA: ORgan-Centroid Aggregation for Training-Free 3D CT Visual Token Compression
summary: ORCA (ORgan-Centroid Aggregation) is a method for training-free 3D CT visual token compression, designed to efficiently reduce the long sequences of visual tokens from CT scans for language models.

title: The 1st AI Children Challenge
summary: The first AI Children Challenge aims to advance computer vision and AI applications in child healthcare, education, and pediatrics, featuring a track on children's gait visual analysis.

title: Artificial Intelligence for the Characterization of Particles and Fibers by Optical Microscopy
summary: This paper introduces an AI distillation framework for characterizing particles and fibers by analyzing optical microscopy images, interpreting visual cues related to specimen morphology and chemical composition.

title: Decoding Children's Gait Behavior
summary: This work introduces a new problem domain for human action recognition, focusing on the fine-grained analysis of children's gait behaviors from standard RGB video for diagnostic and treatment purposes.

title: Boosting Generalizable Depth Estimation in Endoscopy by Mixture of Lightweight Experts and Intrinsic Image Alignment
summary: This paper presents a novel self-supervised framework to improve generalizable depth estimation and ego-motion in endoscopic surgeries by addressing challenges like illumination interference and feature diversity.

title: Beyond Static Anchors: Bounded Prototype Conditioning for Language-Free Medical Anomaly Detection
summary: This research proposes a method called bounded prototype conditioning for language-free medical anomaly detection, aiming to identify abnormal images and localize lesions with limited supervision.

title: Reconstruction-Shift Discrimination via Mask-Guided Latent Diffusion for Medical Anomaly Detection
summary: This paper introduces reconstruction-shift discrimination via mask-guided latent diffusion for unsupervised medical anomaly detection, which identifies deviations from normal anatomical patterns in images.

title: Structured Proxy Features for Multimodal NSCLC Survival Prediction from Pretreatment CT
summary: This work investigates structured proxy features for multimodal prediction of non-small cell lung cancer survival using pretreatment CT scans, aiming to improve survival stratification.

title: Scene2Sound: Auditory-Grounded Soundscape Generation for 3D Gaussian Worlds
summary: Scene2Sound introduces a method for auditory-grounded soundscape generation for 3D Gaussian Splatting worlds, providing dynamic sound that corresponds to explored 3D environments.

title: CrossProjection: Geometric Grounding Beyond Viewpoint Change in Architectural Drawings
summary: This paper introduces CrossProjection, an anchor-grounded diagnostic method for geometric grounding in architectural drawings that accounts for appearance changes beyond simple viewpoint shifts.

title: DreamTraj: Generating 6-DoF Object Trajectories by Reading Unrendered Video Diffusion Latents
summary: DreamTraj is a method that generates 6-degree-of-freedom object trajectories by interpreting unrendered video diffusion latents, crucial for perception-action loops in manipulation.

title: Image-Space Rule Discovery
summary: This research investigates whether image-editing models can discover visual rules in image space and perform end-to-end problem-solving, similar to human IQ tests.

title: SpatialAfford: Teaching Compact VLMs Where to Look and Where to Ground for Affordance
summary: SpatialAfford is a method designed to teach compact Vision-Language Models how to localize functional regions for affordance grounding, which is crucial for interaction with objects.

title: RadYOLO: Computationally Efficient 3D Object Detection and Segmentation in CT and MRI
summary: RadYOLO is introduced as a computationally efficient model for 3D object detection and segmentation in medical images like CT and MRI, offering broad applicability and high performance.

title: Test-time Adaptation of Pelvic Bone Segmentation Models via Dynamic Reliability-Guided
summary: This research proposes a dynamic reliability-guided method for test-time adaptation of pelvic bone segmentation models from CT scans, crucial for robust performance in robot-assisted surgery.

title: GuideGround: VLM-guided Semantic Understanding and Viewpoint-aware Reasoning for 3D Visual Grounding
summary: GuideGround is a new method for 3D visual grounding that uses VLM-guided semantic understanding and viewpoint-aware reasoning to localize target objects in 3D scenes from natural language queries.

title: Unleashing the Power of Text: Text-Guided Flow Matching for Image Fusion under Complex Degradations
summary: This paper introduces Text-Guided Flow Matching for robust infrared-visible image fusion, leveraging textual information to improve performance under complex degradation scenarios.

title: DocPO: Advancing Document Policy Optimization via Tailored Step-Aware Rewards
summary: DocPO advances document policy optimization by employing tailored step-aware rewards in reinforcement learning, aiming to improve accuracy in document parsing tasks.

title: Hybrid-Domain Posterior Sampling for Inverse Problems via Latent Flow Matching
summary: This paper introduces Hybrid-Domain Posterior Sampling for Inverse Problems via Latent Flow Matching, aiming to overcome limitations in applying latent flow models to high-fidelity inverse problems.

title: DiffuseAgent-MI: Distributionally-Grounded,Tool-Integrated Self-Evolving Agents for Faithful Visual Reasoning
summary: DiffuseAgent-MI introduces distributionally-grounded, tool-integrated, self-evolving agents designed for faithful visual reasoning, aiming to improve reliability in safety-critical applications.

title: Zero-Cost Virtual RNA: Approximating Immunotherapy Signatures via Cross-Modal WSI Retrieval
summary: This research proposes "Zero-Cost Virtual RNA," a method using cross-modal Whole Slide Imaging retrieval to approximate immunotherapy signatures for predicting gastric adenocarcinoma response.

title: DrawAI: Agentic Benchmark and Workflow for Making Raster Images Editable
summary: Introduces DrawAI, an agentic benchmark and workflow designed to make raster images generated by multimodal agents editable by addressing the challenge of flattened content.

title: Test-Time Curriculum for Open-Set AIGC Detection
summary: Proposes a test-time curriculum method for open-set AI-generated content (AIGC) detection to address distribution shifts caused by new generative models.

title: Beyond Token-Level Cross-Entropy: Fr\'echet Distributional Post-Training for Autoregressive Image Generation
summary: Introduces Fréchet Distributional Post-Training for autoregressive image generators to address the objective mismatch between token-level cross-entropy pretraining and image-level distributional evaluation.

title: Track-Guided Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning for Autonomous Vehicle Drifting with Minimum-Lap-Time Planning
summary: Proposes a track-guided hierarchical reinforcement learning approach to enable autonomous vehicles to perform drifting maneuvers for minimum lap-time planning in rally racing.

title: Developing Combined Manipulation and Locomotion Skills with Interaction Representation and Skill Composition
summary: Presents a method for humanoid robots to learn combined manipulation and locomotion skills through interaction representation and skill composition, focusing on whole-body reaching, grasping, and policy combination.

title: Compliant Sphere Lattice Contact: Distributed Contact Modeling for Sphere-Based Robot Representations
summary: Introduces Compliant Sphere Lattice Contact, a distributed contact modeling approach for sphere-based robot representations, aiming to improve physical accuracy while maintaining computational efficiency for contact planning.

title: Localization in Spatiotemporal Fields via Environmental PDEs
summary: Proposes a localization framework that utilizes spatiotemporal fields governed by partial differential equations (PDEs) as unique localization signatures in environments like coastal waters.

title: Hybrid Attention Estimation Pipeline for Adaptive HRI Using an Expressive Robotic Head
summary: Presents a hybrid visual attention estimation pipeline for adaptive human-robot interaction using an expressive robotic head within the InMoov ecosystem.

title: Towards General Language-Conditioned Latent Safety Filters
summary: Explores the development of general language-conditioned latent safety filters to enable safe deployment of vision-language-action (VLA) models in robots, adapting to diverse tasks and safety requirements.

title: Action Chunk Scheduling for Batched Robot Policy Serving
summary: Introduces Action Chunk Scheduling as a method for batched robot policy serving to efficiently deploy computationally demanding Vision-Language-Action (VLA) foundation models on general-purpose robots with constrained on-device compute.

title: A Robotic System for Automated Manufacturing of Dielectric Elastomer Actuators
summary: Presents an automated robotic manufacturing system designed for the production of soft capacitors, which function as dielectric elastomer actuators and sensors, emphasizing critical process steps.

title: The Gate, Not the Cache: Gate Provenance Bounds the Closed-Loop Reliability of Training-Free VLA Token Skipping
summary: Investigates the closed-loop reliability of training-free Vision-Language-Action (VLA) token skipping by analyzing gate provenance, a method used to accelerate VLA models.

title: Embodied Passive Aeroacoustic Perception Enables Relative Sensing and Pursuit Between Aerial Robots
summary: Explores embodied passive aeroacoustic perception as a novel method for aerial robots to achieve relative sensing and pursuit, overcoming challenges like ego-acoustic interference.

title: Learning to Predict Contact Force Distributions from Vision Leveraging Object Geometry Priors
summary: Describes a method for robots to learn to predict contact force distributions from vision by leveraging object geometry priors, aiming to improve manipulation strategies.

title: From Digital to Physical Reservoir Computing: Co-Optimizing Soft Robotic Reservoirs via Dynamics Matching
summary: Investigates co-optimizing soft robotic substrates for Physical Reservoir Computing (PRC) using dynamics matching to leverage their compliant nonlinear dynamics for temporal memory and efficient inference.

title: First Deployable Dynamic-CoM: A Unified Policy and Method-Agnostic Benchmark for Humanoid Single-Leg Balance
summary: Introduces Dynamic-CoM, the first deployable and method-agnostic benchmark designed to evaluate humanoid robots' single-leg balance performance using unified policies.

title: DexMani: Human-Derived Manipulability Guidance for Dexterous Rotation
summary: Presents DexMani, a method that uses human-derived manipulability guidance to improve dexterous object rotation for robots, addressing the sequential contact problem.

title: Latency-Tolerant Cloud-Edge Collaborative Vision-Language-Action Models via Emergent Representational Specialization
summary: Proposes latency-tolerant cloud-edge collaborative Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models with emergent representational specialization to efficiently deploy large VLA policies on mobile robots despite network delays.

title: Grasp Execution Without a Planner: Configuration-Space Grasp Distance Fields with Certified Safety & Guaranteed Quality
summary: Introduces a method for multifingered robot grasp execution using configuration-space grasp distance fields, enabling certified safety and guaranteed quality without relying on a separate planner.

title: From Failures to Supervision: DynamicEnvPlan for Robust Long-Horizon Embodied Planning
summary: Introduces DynamicEnvPlan, a method for robust long-horizon embodied planning that enables agents to adapt to dynamic environments and execution uncertainty by learning from failures.

title: Learning-Based Motion Planning for Dynamic Environments: From Foundational Algorithms to Emerging Paradigms
summary: This paper explores learning-based motion planning algorithms for robots operating in dynamic environments, focusing on generating safe and efficient paths and control actions. It discusses applications in fields like autonomous driving.

title: FlowPilot: Real-Time World-Action Modeling for Agile UAV Navigation
summary: FlowPilot is a compact world-action model designed for real-time onboard UAV navigation, utilizing depth information to jointly denoise future observations and predict executable trajectories. It aims to improve agile drone navigation by explicitly predicting scenes.

title: Assistant Placement Aria: A Benchmark for Egocentric Placement Assistance
summary: Assistant Placement Aria is a new benchmark designed to evaluate egocentric placement assistance in robotics, focusing on selecting target destinations that align with human intentions. It addresses the challenge of Virtual Placement within human-robot interaction.

title: OmniAI: A Surface-Adaptive Aerial Projection Interface for Human--Drone Interaction
summary: OmniAI is an embodied aerial agent that provides a surface-adaptive projection interface for human-drone interaction, switching projections between an onboard screen and environmental surfaces. This aims to improve situated communication in human environments.

title: SelfWAM: A Self-Grounded Unified World Action Model for Fast Robot Control
summary: SelfWAM is a self-grounded unified World Action Model designed for fast robot control, which improves robot policy learning by jointly modeling actions and future observations. It aims to capture action-specific consequences for better control.

title: Push-Wiper: Toward General-Purpose Robotic Cleaning across Varied Stains and Surfaces with Segmented Pushing Trajectories
summary: Push-Wiper is a proposed method for general-purpose robotic surface cleaning that uses segmented pushing trajectories to effectively remove viscous stains across varied surfaces without spreading or damage.

title: When Prompts Control Robots: Prompt Injection Attacks in Multi-Agent Robotic Systems
summary: This paper investigates prompt injection attacks in multi-agent robotic systems that integrate large language models for task planning and control. It highlights how these attacks can lead to unsafe decisions and physical harm, especially in multi-agent settings.

title: ORCESTRA: VLM-driven Visual Robot programming in Mixed Reality
summary: ORCESTRA is a mixed-reality system that enables visual robot programming of digital twins through no-code waypoint teaching and language-guided control. It allows users to teach trajectories and issue commands in a passthrough mixed-reality workspace.

title: SIPTraj: Map-Free End-to-End Trajectory Prediction via Physics-Guided Scene Interaction
summary: SIPTraj is a map-free, end-to-end trajectory prediction method that uses physics-guided scene interaction for safe planning and decision making in autonomous driving. It addresses the challenge of predicting trajectories without high-definition maps.

title: DynamicWAM: Dual-Path Motion Conditioning for World-Action Models in Dynamic Manipulation
summary: DynamicWAM is a proposed World-Action Model featuring dual-path motion conditioning, designed to improve responsive control for robots in dynamic manipulation tasks. It addresses limitations of existing WAMs by enhancing motion awareness in dynamic scenes.

title: LooperMuscle: Fast and Stable Learning of Humanoid Whole-Body Tracking via Structured Mixture-of-Experts
summary: LooperMuscle is a composed expert policy learning framework that aims to achieve fast and stable learning for humanoid whole-body tracking. It addresses the speed-performance gap in humanoid motion training methods.

title: GeminiPainter's sequence-formed pipeline comprised of perception, cognition, planning, and action stages
summary: GeminiPainter is an autonomous robotic system that generates portraits by combining real-time face detection, AI-based sketch generation using the Gemini Vision API, and robotic drawing. The system integrates perception, cognition, planning, and action stages.

title: Minute-Scale Training for Microrobot Navigation
summary: This paper presents a method for minute-scale training of microrobots, aiming to improve autonomous navigation capabilities through deep reinforcement learning. It addresses the challenges of targeted navigation in microrobot applications.

title: Bicycle Acrobatics with Reinforcement Learning
summary: This research uses Reinforcement Learning to enable a bicycle robot to learn and execute a diverse repertoire of dynamic and agile acrobatic maneuvers. It addresses the challenges posed by the robot's underactuated and non-holonomic dynamics.

title: Stipple: Real-Time Incremental Gaussian Splatting with Visual-Inertial Tracking
summary: Stipple introduces a method for real-time incremental Gaussian Splatting combined with visual-inertial tracking to enable efficient 3D scene reconstruction. This technique is designed for applications requiring immediate feedback, such as in robotics and XR.

title: GraRe: Grasp Candidate Re-Ranking for Frozen 6-DoF Grasp Detectors
summary: GraRe proposes a method for re-ranking grasp candidates for 6-DoF grasp detectors, aiming to improve grasp quality alignment beyond detector confidence. This addresses the issue of successful grasp candidates being ranked too low in robotic manipulation.

title: FreqNav: Stage-Wise Frequency Routing for Object-Oriented Aerial Vision-Language Navigation
summary: FreqNav introduces a stage-wise frequency routing method for object-oriented aerial vision-language navigation (VLN), enabling drones to search for described targets and perform precise landings. It dynamically adjusts perceptual priorities based on target instructions.

title: RL Bootstrapping of OpenVLA-OFT for a Novel Robot Embodiment
summary: This research explores RL bootstrapping of OpenVLA-OFT to adapt a pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) policy to novel robot embodiments. It addresses the challenge of transferring policies to custom robots with different morphologies without extensive demonstrations.

title: KING: Embodiment-Aware Kinematic Graph Neural Network for Unified Motion Representation of Legged and Wheeled Robots
summary: KING (Kinematic Graph Neural Network) proposes an embodiment-aware model for unified motion representation and odometry estimation for both legged and wheeled robots. It aims to provide accurate odometry in challenging featureless environments.

title: VLAGuard: A Framework for Evaluating and Mitigating Physical Attention Hijacking in Vision-Language-Action Robots within Wireless Sensor Networks
summary: VLAGuard is a framework designed to evaluate and mitigate "physical attention hijacking," a critical vulnerability in Vision-Language-Action (VLA) robots deployed within wireless sensor networks. It aims to protect against adversarial threats.

title: Diffusion-Based Body Schema Learning Enabling Abnormal-State Adaptation in Musculoskeletal Robots
summary: This research presents a diffusion-based body schema learning method for musculoskeletal robots, enabling them to adapt to abnormal states like muscle rupture or actuator jamming. It addresses consistency challenges under various physical state changes for these robots.

title: WAM-Diff2: Hierarchical AR-to-Diffusion Distillation for Highly Efficient Autonomous Driving VLA
summary: This paper introduces WAM-Diff2, a hierarchical AR-to-diffusion distillation method to improve the efficiency of Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models for autonomous driving. It aims to overcome high computational latency and exposure bias in existing VLA models.

title: OC-VLA++: Monocular Geometry-Guided Cross-View Consistency for Viewpoint-Robust Robotic Manipulation
summary: OC-VLA++ is proposed as an extension for viewpoint-robust robotic manipulation under limited camera coverage, using monocular geometry-guided cross-view consistency. It aims to improve generalization by preventing overfitting to limited viewpoints in robot action grounding.

title: VespaSeg: A Resource-Aware Ground-then-Segment Pipeline for Referring Expression Segmentation
summary: VespaSeg is a modular, resource-aware pipeline for referring expression segmentation that uses a compact vision-language model to ground text queries and then converts the predicted box to a mask. It aims to provide efficient language-conditioned localization and pixel-accurate masks.

title: Sparse Meets Dense: Correspondence Guided Robotic Manipulation with Rigid-Deformable Interactions
summary: This research explores correspondence-guided robotic manipulation, focusing on challenging rigid-deformable interactions like hanging clothes or dressing humans. It aims to enhance the capabilities of household robots in these complex tasks.

title: CAAT: Contact-Aware Attention Scaling and Tactile Masking for Data-Efficient Contact-Rich Manipulation
summary: CAAT (Contact-Aware Attention Scaling and Tactile Masking) is a method proposed for data-efficient contact-rich robotic manipulation. It uses visual and tactile observations within Transformer-based policies to guide motion, particularly leveraging tactile data during contact.

title: FeDepth: Federated Learning for Depth Estimation under Robot Heterogeneity
summary: FeDepth applies federated learning for depth estimation in robot perception to improve generalization across heterogeneous robot platforms. This approach aims to overcome the inefficiencies of centralized learning with diverse environmental data.

title: PRISM: Privileged Probabilistic Latent Supervision for End-to-End Autonomous Driving Motion Planning
summary: PRISM introduces Privileged Probabilistic Latent Supervision to improve the training of end-to-end autonomous driving motion planning systems. It addresses the issue of weak gradients in hidden layers by providing more robust supervision than standard output-only methods.

title: EndoWAM: A Grounded World-Action Model for Generalizable Endoscopic Navigation
summary: EndoWAM is a grounded World-Action Model designed for generalizable autonomous endoscopic navigation. It aims to provide robust control for endoscopes, addressing challenges like tissue deformation and rapidly changing viewpoints.

title: Hermite Curves as Trajectory Priors for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: This research proposes using Hermite Curves as trajectory priors for Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models to improve robotic manipulation. It aims to provide more structured action interfaces, reducing jagged motion and boundary discontinuities compared to per-timestep controls.

title: DreamTrajectory: Trajectory-Guided Action Generation with World Model Alignment for Mobile Manipulation
summary: DreamTrajectory introduces a trajectory-guided action generation method with World Model Alignment for mobile manipulation. It aims to improve how robots coordinate base and arm motion under changing conditions, addressing limitations in existing Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies.

title: SG-WAM: Self-Guided World Modeling in Geometry-Aware Policy Space
summary: SG-WAM proposes a self-guided world modeling approach in a geometry-aware policy space to enhance World Action Models (WAMs). It aims to improve the effectiveness of action generation coupled with future state prediction by aligning dynamics modeling with action and scene geometry.
